title: Veil and Thorn
author: Isandro Sandoval
blurb: Ada Joubert, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
